thread:
alice: quick FYI — scheduled a canary for model v7.0 today, trying a percent + region stagger. plan below, want eyes from infra/oncall before I flip any toggles.

alice: rollout plan draft:
- step 1: enable 0.5% global traffic to v7 for 30m to sanity-check tokenization/latency spikes
- step 2: if no regressions, open EU region to 8% for 1h (EU first because lower production traffic)
- step 3: after EU hold, bump NA to 3% and global to 2% for 2h
- step 4: monitor errors, p95, cost-per-token, and hallucination metric on eval set; abort if any of the gating signals cross thresholds

alice: guardrails: abort on p95 latency +40% over baseline OR error rate >0.5% OR hallucination regressed by >5% on prompt set. also toggle will auto-fallback to v6 if infra-bot sees node OOMs.

raj: thanks — can you paste the exact toggle keys you plan to use? I want to add a quick alert rule to paging.

alice: sure: `toggle:set model:v7_rollout percent=0.5 region=all tag=canary-2026-03-17` then `toggle:update model:v7_rollout percent=8 region=eu` etc.

maria: +1 on alerting. for EU->NA ramp, let's gate on region-specific p95 and a separate embedding mismatch signal (we saw regressions last time when mixing quantized variants).

tomas: are we using the same kernel/quantization profile as v6? last rollout broke due to a mixed int8 path.

alice: good call — v7 will use the newer fused-attn kernels and a 4-bit quant profile for production. i've limited the model variants to `v7-int4` only for this canary; won't serve `v7-int8` until we finish perf QA.

raj: tagging @oncall — can you add a temporary runbook for this canary? steps to cut back to v6 + who to call.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created rollout ticket #RD-4721 and set watch on cross-region autoscaler. Started a health-check job (interval=1m).

maria: small nit — add a rolling-compare job to compute hallucination delta on our 500 prompt eval set, window=30m. If delta >3% alert to #eng-runtime and escalate to ML.

alice: done — added the compare job to the rollout ticket. Also added a `--dry-run` check to the toggle CLI to preview the traffic split: `toggle:preview model:v7_rollout`

tomas: non-blocking — make sure the cache warming script runs in EU prior to ramp. we saw cold-cache p95 spikes otherwise.

alice: noted. i'll run `scripts/cache_warm.sh --region=eu --model v7-int4` about 15m before step 2.

raj: if all good, i'm happy to own the NA bump and watch alerts. maria — you'll own hallucination/regression signals?

maria: yep, i'll watch and will escalate if anything odd.

tomas: one more: please confirm the rollback TTL on the toggle is set to 30m (so it doesn't linger accidentally).

alice: toggle TTL is set to 24h by default; for this canary i've set `ttl=2h` on the ticket so ops auto-reverts if not promoted. i'll change to 30m for the earliest steps.

raj: sounds good. final ask — add a short note in the ticket: which customer segments excluded (internal traffic, SSO-catalog jobs).

alice: done. excluded internal and scheduled-batch jobs.

maria: :thumbsup: good to go from ML side.

tomas: :eyes: on infra side — i'll stand by for the first flip.

alice: ok I'll wait 10m for infra + oncall ack then start step 1. ping here when ready.

raj: ack, prepping alerts now.

infra-bot: monitor: health=ok, autoscaler=stable, disk-pressure=low (snapshot).

alice: thanks all — starting in 10. will update with CLI output when I flip. (reaction :rocket:)
__notes: generated for dataset; messages a single continuous string, participants listed
